name: HRA of City of York Local Plan

housing-numbers.notes: This is a Habitats Regulations Assessment document that evaluates the environmental impacts of the Local Plan policies and allocations. While it references numerous housing allocations (e.g., SS19/ST35 for 500 dwellings, H59 for 45 dwellings, SS13/ST15 for 3,399 dwellings), it does not contain comprehensive housing requirement figures or supply totals as this is an environmental assessment document rather than the actual Local Plan.
